<?php
class Search {
    private $rules = array();
    public function set_rules($data) {
        foreach (array_keys($data) as $rule) {
            if (preg_match('/^rule_(\d+)$/', $rule, $m)) {
                $this->rules[] = array('recent', $data['rule_' . $m[1] . '_input'] ?? '');
            }
        }
    }
    public function to_sql() {
        $table = array();
        foreach ($this->rules as $rule) {
            $input = $rule[1];
            $key = md5($input);
            $table['addition_' . $key] = "LEFT JOIN (SELECT `id` FROM `album` ORDER BY `id` DESC LIMIT $input) AS `addition_$key`";
        }
        return 'SELECT * FROM `album` ' . implode(' ', $table);
    }
}

<?php
class ModHelper {
    public static function getStatsByType($year) {
        $latest = self::getLatestYear();
        if (($year > $latest) or !(ctype_digit($year))) {
            $year = $latest;
        }
        $query = 'SELECT arten.title AS label, count(data1) AS value
                  FROM #__eiko_einsatzberichte AS berichte
                  WHERE berichte.state=1 AND berichte.date1 LIKE \'' . $year . '%\'';

        $data = $input->get('data');
        return json_encode(self::getStatsByType($data));
    }

public function list_keywords($event) {
    $keywords = $this->request->variable('keywords', '');
